     1→import pptxgen from 'pptxgenjs';

     7→// Photo dimensions in inches
     8→const PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_W = 4.4;
     9→const PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H = 2.8;
    10→const PHOTO_PORTRAIT_W = 3.28;   // 8.3 cm
    11→const PHOTO_PORTRAIT_H = 3.27;   // 8.34 cm

    13→// Sanitize text for use in filenames
    14→function sanitizeForFilename(text: string): string {
    15→  return text
    16→    .trim()
    17→    .substring(0, 60)
    18→    .replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*\x00-\x1f]/g, '')
    19→    .replace(/\s+/g, '_')
    20→    .replace(/_+/g, '_')
    21→    .replace(/^_|_$/g, '')
    22→    || 'Inspecao';
    23→}
    24→
    25→// Helper function to generate a black image with white text
    26→function generateSerialNumberImage(serialNumber: string): string {
    27→  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    28→  const width = 400;
    29→  const height = 400;
    30→  canvas.width = width;
    31→  canvas.height = height;
    32→  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    33→  
    34→  if (ctx) {
    35→    // Black background
    36→    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    37→    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    38→    
    39→    // White text
    40→    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    41→    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial';
    42→    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    43→    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    44→    
    45→    // Draw serial number
    46→    const displayText = serialNumber || 'N/A';
    47→    ctx.fillText(displayText, width / 2, height / 2);
    48→  }
    49→  
    50→  return canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    51→}

    83→
    84→export async function generatePowerPoint(options: PowerPointOptions): Promise<void> {
    85→  const { inspection, photos, additionalParts, conclusion, language = 'pt', reportId, translatedData } = options;
    86→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
    87→  
    88→  // Use translated data if available, otherwise use original
    89→  const finalInspection = translatedData?.inspection || inspection;
    90→  const finalPhotos = translatedData?.photos || photos;
    91→  const finalConclusion = translatedData?.conclusion || conclusion;
    92→  
    93→  const pptx = new pptxgen();
    94→  
    95→  // Set presentation properties
    96→  pptx.author = 'Z-Services AI';
    97→  pptx.title = `Relatório Técnico - ${finalInspection.tag || 'Máquina'}`;
    98→  pptx.subject = finalInspection.descricao || 'Inspeção Técnica';
    99→  
   100→  // Generate slides
   101→  generateCoverSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language, reportId);
   102→  
   103→  // Slide de Identificação da Máquina (sempre gerado)
   104→  await generateMachineIdentificationSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language);
   105→  
   106→  await generatePhotoSlides(pptx, finalPhotos, language);
   107→  generatePartsTableSlides(pptx, finalPhotos, additionalParts, language);
   108→  
   109→  if (finalConclusion.trim()) {
   110→    generateConclusionSlide(pptx, finalConclusion, language);
   111→  }
   112→  
   113→  generateFinalSlide(pptx, language, reportId);
   114→  
   115→  // Save the file
   116→  const fileName = `Relatorio_${sanitizeForFilename(finalInspection.descricao || finalInspection.tag)}_${reportId || ''}_${formatDateForFileName(finalInspection.data)}.pptx`.replace(/__+/g, '_');
   117→  const blob = await pptx.write({ outputType: 'blob' }) as Blob;
   118→  saveAs(blob, fileName);
   119→}

   124→export async function generateHomePowerPoint(options: HomePowerPointOptions): Promise<void> {
   125→  const { inspection, categories, conclusion, language = 'pt', reportId, translatedData } = options;
   126→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   127→  
   128→  // Use translated data if available, otherwise use original
   129→  const finalInspection = translatedData?.inspection || inspection;
   130→  const finalCategories = translatedData?.categories || categories;
   131→  const finalConclusion = translatedData?.conclusion || conclusion;
   132→  
   133→  const pptx = new pptxgen();
   134→  
   135→  // Set presentation properties
   136→  pptx.author = 'Z-Services AI';
   137→  pptx.title = `Relatório Técnico - ${finalInspection.tag || 'Máquina'}`;
   138→  pptx.subject = finalInspection.descricao || 'Inspeção Técnica';
   139→  
   140→  // Generate slides
   141→  generateCoverSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language, reportId);
   142→  
   143→  // Slide de Identificação da Máquina (sempre gerado)
   144→  await generateMachineIdentificationSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language);
   145→  
   146→  // Generate category slides
   147→  for (const [index, category] of finalCategories.entries()) {
   148→    const photosWithImages = category.photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   149→    if (photosWithImages.length > 0) {
   150→      await generateCategorySlides(pptx, category, index + 1, language);
   151→    }
   152→  }
   153→
   154→  // Collect all parts from all categories for the parts table
   155→  const allPhotos: PhotoData[] = [];
   156→  const allAdditionalParts: AdditionalPart[] = [];
   157→  finalCategories.forEach(category => {
   158→    allPhotos.push(...category.photos);
   159→    allAdditionalParts.push(...category.additionalParts);
   160→  });
   161→  
   162→  generatePartsTableSlides(pptx, allPhotos, allAdditionalParts, language);
   163→  
   164→  if (finalConclusion.trim()) {
   165→    generateConclusionSlide(pptx, finalConclusion, language);
   166→  }
   167→  
   168→  generateFinalSlide(pptx, language, reportId);
   169→  
   170→  // Save the file
   171→  const fileName = `Relatorio_Home_${sanitizeForFilename(finalInspection.descricao || finalInspection.tag)}_${reportId || ''}_${formatDateForFileName(finalInspection.data)}.pptx`.replace(/__+/g, '_');
   172→  const blob = await pptx.write({ outputType: 'blob' }) as Blob;
   173→  saveAs(blob, fileName);
   174→}

   176→// Helper function to get translated category title and description
   177→function getCategoryTranslation(categoryId: string, language: Language): { title: string; description: string } {
   178→  const titleKey = `category.${categoryId}`;
   179→  const descKey = `category.${categoryId}Desc`;
   180→  
   181→  return {
   182→    title: t(titleKey, language, { defaultValue: categoryId }),
   183→    description: t(descKey, language, { defaultValue: '' }),
   184→  };
   185→}

   187→/**
   188→ * Detect photo orientation and return appropriate PPT dimensions.
   189→ */
   190→async function getPhotoDimensions(photo: PhotoData): Promise<{ w: number; h: number; isPortrait: boolean }> {
   191→  const imgData = photo.editedImageData || photo.imageData;
   192→  if (!imgData) return { w: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_W, h: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H, isPortrait: false };
   193→  try {
   194→    const info = await getImageInfo(imgData);
   195→    return info.isPortrait
   196→      ? { w: PHOTO_PORTRAIT_W, h: PHOTO_PORTRAIT_H, isPortrait: true }
   197→      : { w: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_W, h: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H, isPortrait: false };
   198→  } catch {
   199→    return { w: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_W, h: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H, isPortrait: false };
   200→  }
   201→}
   202→
   203→/**
   204→ * Calculate x,y positions for 1 or 2 photos on a slide,
   205→ * centering them horizontally.
   206→ */
   207→function layoutPhotos(
   208→  dims1: { w: number; h: number } | null,
   209→  dims2: { w: number; h: number } | null,
   210→  y: number,
   211→  gap: number
   212→): Array<{ photo: PhotoData; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number } | null> {
   213→  const result: Array<{ photo: PhotoData; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number } | null> = [null, null];
   214→  
   215→  if (!dims1 && !dims2) return result;
   216→  
   217→  if (dims1 && !dims2) {
   218→    // Single photo: center it
   219→    result[0] = { photo: null!, x: (10 - dims1.w) / 2, y, w: dims1.w, h: dims1.h };
   220→    return result;
   221→  }
   222→  
   223→  if (dims1 && dims2) {
   224→    // Two photos: center them together
   225→    const totalW = dims1.w + gap + dims2.w;
   226→    const startX = (10 - totalW) / 2;
   227→    result[0] = { photo: null!, x: startX, y, w: dims1.w, h: dims1.h };
   228→    result[1] = { photo: null!, x: startX + dims1.w + gap, y, w: dims2.w, h: dims2.h };
   229→    return result;
   230→  }
   231→  
   232→  // Only dims2 (shouldn't happen)
   233→  result[1] = { photo: null!, x: (10 - dims2.w) / 2, y, w: dims2.w, h: dims2.h };
   234→  return result;
   235→}
   236→
   237→async function generateCategorySlides(
   238→  pptx: pptxgen, 
   239→  category: PhotoCategory, 
   240→  categoryNumber: number,
   241→  language: Language
   242→) {
   243→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   244→  const photosWithImages = category.photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   245→  const slideCount = Math.ceil(photosWithImages.length / 2);
   246→  
   247→  // Get translated title
   248→  const { title: translatedTitle } = getCategoryTranslation(category.id, language);
   249→  
   250→  for (let i = 0; i < slideCount; i++) {
   251→    const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   252→    
   253→    // Header with category number (use translated title, no line break)
   254→    addCategoryHeader(slide, `${categoryNumber}. ${translatedTitle.toUpperCase()}`);
   255→    
   256→    const photo1 = photosWithImages[i * 2];
   257→    const photo2 = photosWithImages[i * 2 + 1];
   258→    
   259→    // Detect orientation for each photo
   260→    const dims1 = photo1 ? await getPhotoDimensions(photo1) : null;
   261→    const dims2 = photo2 ? await getPhotoDimensions(photo2) : null;
   262→    const positions = layoutPhotos(dims1, dims2, 1.7, 0.2);
   263→    
   264→    // Photo 1
   265→    if (photo1?.imageData && positions[0]) {
   266→      await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo1, positions[0].x, positions[0].y, positions[0].w, positions[0].h, language);
   267→    }
   268→    
   269→    // Photo 2
   270→    if (photo2?.imageData && positions[1]) {
   271→      await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo2, positions[1].x, positions[1].y, positions[1].w, positions[1].h, language);
   272→    }
   273→    
   274→    addStandardFooter(slide);
   275→  }
   276→}

   453→async function generateMachineIdentificationSlide(pptx: pptxgen, inspection: InspectionData, language: Language) {
   454→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   455→  const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   456→  addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'MACHINE IDENTIFICATION' : 'IDENTIFICAÇÃO DA MÁQUINA');
   457→  
   458→  // Title
   459→  slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'Machine Identification' : 'Identificação da Máquina', {
   460→    x: 0.3,
   461→    y: 1.1,
   462→    w: 9.4,
   463→    h: 0.4,
   464→    fontSize: 16,
   465→    bold: true,
   466→    color: '000000',
   467→    fontFace: 'Arial',
   468→    align: 'center',
   469→  });
   470→  
   471→  // Photo positions (4 columns) - centered on slide
   472→  const photoWidth = 2.1;
   473→  const photoHeight = 2.1;
   474→  const gap = 0.3;
   475→  const totalWidth = (photoWidth * 4) + (gap * 3);
   476→  const startX = (10 - totalWidth) / 2; // Center the photo group
   477→  const photoY = 1.7;
   478→  
   479→  // Photo 1: Equipamento
   480→  const photo1X = startX;
   481→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   482→    x: photo1X,
   483→    y: photoY,
   484→    w: photoWidth,
   485→    h: photoHeight,
   486→    fill: { color: 'F5F5F5' },
   487→    line: { color: 'CCCCCC', width: 2, dashType: 'dash' },
   488→  });
   489→  
   490→  if (inspection.machinePhoto) {
   491→    const processed = await maybeCoverCropImage(inspection.machinePhoto, { targetW: photoWidth, targetH: photoHeight });
   492→    slide.addImage({
   493→      data: processed,
   494→      x: photo1X,
   495→      y: photoY,
   496→      w: photoWidth,
   497→      h: photoHeight,
   498→    });
   499→  } else {
   500→    // Placeholder with camera icon
   501→    slide.addText('📷', {
   502→      x: photo1X,
   503→      y: photoY + photoHeight / 2 - 0.4,
   504→      w: photoWidth,
   505→      h: 0.5,
   506→      fontSize: 24,
   507→      color: 'CCCCCC',
   508→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   509→      align: 'center',
   510→    });
   511→    slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'Equipment Photo' : 'Foto do Equipamento', {
   512→      x: photo1X,
   513→      y: photoY + photoHeight / 2 + 0.1,
   514→      w: photoWidth,
   515→      h: 0.35,
   516→      fontSize: 8,
   517→      color: '999999',
   518→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   519→      align: 'center',
   520→      italic: true,
   521→    });
   522→  }
   523→  
   524→  // Label 1: TAG
   525→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   526→    x: photo1X,
   527→    y: photoY + photoHeight,
   528→    w: photoWidth,
   529→    h: 0.4,
   530→    fill: { color: 'FF6600' },
   531→  });
   532→  slide.addText(inspection.tag || (isTranslated ? 'Equipment TAG' : 'TAG do Equipamento'), {
   533→    x: photo1X,
   534→    y: photoY + photoHeight + 0.03,
   535→    w: photoWidth,
   536→    h: 0.35,
   537→    fontSize: 9,
   538→    bold: true,
   539→    color: 'FFFFFF',
   540→    fontFace: 'Arial',
   541→    align: 'center',
   542→  });
   543→  
   544→  // Photo 2: Horímetro
   545→  const photo2X = startX + photoWidth + gap;
   546→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   547→    x: photo2X,
   548→    y: photoY,
   549→    w: photoWidth,
   550→    h: photoHeight,
   551→    fill: { color: 'F5F5F5' },
   552→    line: { color: 'CCCCCC', width: 2, dashType: 'dash' },

   554→  
   555→  if (inspection.horimetroPhoto) {
   556→    const processed = await maybeCoverCropImage(inspection.horimetroPhoto, { targetW: photoWidth, targetH: photoHeight });
   557→    slide.addImage({
   558→      data: processed,
   559→      x: photo2X,
   560→      y: photoY,
   561→      w: photoWidth,
   562→      h: photoHeight,
   563→    });
   564→  } else {
   565→    // Placeholder with camera icon
   566→    slide.addText('📷', {
   567→      x: photo2X,
   568→      y: photoY + photoHeight / 2 - 0.4,
   569→      w: photoWidth,
   570→      h: 0.5,
   571→      fontSize: 24,
   572→      color: 'CCCCCC',
   573→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   574→      align: 'center',
   575→    });
   576→    slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'Hour Meter Photo' : 'Foto do Horímetro', {
   577→      x: photo2X,
   578→      y: photoY + photoHeight / 2 + 0.1,
   579→      w: photoWidth,
   580→      h: 0.35,

   639→      color: 'FFFFFF',
   640→      fontFace: 'Arial',

   644→  
   645→  // Label 3: Serial Number

   653→  slide.addText(`${isTranslated ? 'SN' : 'NS'}: ${inspection.sn || '-'}`, {

   664→

   666→  const photo4X = startX + (photoWidth + gap) * 3;
   667→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {

   697→    slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'Location Photo' : 'Foto do Local', {

   732→
   733→async function generatePhotoSlides(pptx: pptxgen, photos: PhotoData[], language: Language) {
   734→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   735→  const photosWithImages = photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   736→  const slideCount = Math.ceil(photosWithImages.length / 2);
   737→  
   738→  for (let i = 0; i < slideCount; i++) {
   739→    const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   740→    addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'PHOTOS' : 'FOTOS');
   741→    
   742→    const photo1 = photosWithImages[i * 2];
   743→    const photo2 = photosWithImages[i * 2 + 1];
   744→    
   745→    // Detect orientation for each photo
   746→    const dims1 = photo1 ? await getPhotoDimensions(photo1) : null;
   747→    const dims2 = photo2 ? await getPhotoDimensions(photo2) : null;
   748→    const positions = layoutPhotos(dims1, dims2, 1.6, 0.2);
   749→    
   750→    // Photo 1
   751→    if (photo1?.imageData && positions[0]) {
   752→      await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo1, positions[0].x, positions[0].y, positions[0].w, positions[0].h, language);
   753→    }
   754→    
   755→    // Photo 2
   756→    if (photo2?.imageData && positions[1]) {
   757→      await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo2, positions[1].x, positions[1].y, positions[1].w, positions[1].h, language);
   758→    }
   759→    
   760→    addStandardFooter(slide);
   761→  }
   762→}
   763→
   764→async function addPhotoToSlide(
   765→  slide: pptxgen.Slide, 
   766→  photo: PhotoData, 
   767→  x: number, 
   768→  y: number, 
   769→  w: number, 
   770→  h: number,
   771→  language: Language
   772→) {
   773→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   774→  
   775→  // Check if we have a secondary photo (two photos side by side)
   776→  const hasSecondaryPhoto = photo.secondaryImageData && photo.imageData;
   777→  
   778→  // Calculate photo widths
   779→  const photoWidth = hasSecondaryPhoto ? (w - 0.1) / 2 : w;
   780→  
   781→  // Photo info overlay (if PN exists)
   782→  if (photo.pn) {
   783→    slide.addShape(slide._slideLayout?._presLayout?.pptx?.ShapeType?.rect || 'rect', {
   784→      x: x,
   785→      y: y - 0.4,
   786→      w: w,
   787→      h: 0.35,
   788→      fill: { color: '000000', transparency: 70 },
   789→    });
   790→    
   791→    let infoText = `${isTranslated ? 'Part Number:' : 'Numero da Peça:'} ${photo.pn}`;
   792→    if (photo.partName) infoText += ` ${photo.partName}`;
   793→    if (photo.quantity) infoText += ` ${isTranslated ? 'Qty:' : 'Qtd:'} ${photo.quantity}`;
   794→    
   795→    slide.addText(infoText, {
   796→      x: x + 0.1,
   797→      y: y - 0.35,
   798→      w: w - 0.2,
   799→      h: 0.25,
   800→      fontSize: 9,
   801→      color: 'FFFFFF',
   802→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   803→    });
   804→  }
   805→  
   806→  // Primary Photo
   807→  if (photo.imageData) {
   808→    const processed = await maybeCoverCropImage(photo.editedImageData || photo.imageData, { targetW: photoWidth, targetH: h });
   809→    slide.addImage({
   810→      data: processed || '',
   811→      x: x,
   812→      y: y,
   813→      w: photoWidth,
   814→      h: h,
   815→    });
   816→  }
   817→  
   818→  // Secondary Photo (lado a lado)
   819→  if (photo.secondaryImageData) {
   820→    const secondX = hasSecondaryPhoto ? x + photoWidth + 0.1 : x;
   821→    const secondW = hasSecondaryPhoto ? photoWidth : w;
   822→    const processed = await maybeCoverCropImage(photo.secondaryImageData, { targetW: secondW, targetH: h });
   823→    slide.addImage({
   824→      data: processed,
   825→      x: secondX,
   826→      y: y,
   827→      w: secondW,
   828→      h: h,
   829→    });
   830→  }
   831→  
   832→  // Description
   833→  if (photo.description) {
   834→    slide.addShape(slide._slideLayout?._presLayout?.pptx?.ShapeType?.rect || 'rect', {
   835→      x: x,
   836→      y: y + h,
   837→      w: w,
   838→      h: 0.6,
   839→      fill: { color: 'FF6600' },
   840→    });
   841→    
   842→    slide.addText(photo.description.substring(0, 150), {
   843→      x: x + 0.1,
   844→      y: y + h + 0.05,
   845→      w: w - 0.2,
   846→      h: 0.5,
   847→      fontSize: 8,
   848→      color: 'FFFFFF',
   849→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   850→    });
   851→  }
   852→}
   853→
   854→// Interface for hierarchical parts structure
   855→interface PartRow {
   856→  pn: string;
   857→  serialNumber: string;
   858→  partName: string;
   859→  quantity: string;
   860→  isSubPart: boolean;
   861→  parentPn?: string;
   862→  indent: number;
   863→}
   864→
   865→function generatePartsTableSlides(
   866→  pptx: pptxgen, 
   867→  photos: PhotoData[], 
   868→  additionalParts: AdditionalPart[],
   869→  language: Language
   870→) {
   871→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   872→  // Build hierarchical parts structure
   873→  const partRows: PartRow[] = [];
   874→  
   875→  // Process each main part and its sub-parts
   876→  photos
   877→    .filter(p => p.pn)
   878→    .forEach(photo => {
   879→      // Add main part
   880→      partRows.push({
   881→        pn: photo.pn,
   882→        serialNumber: photo.serialNumber || '',
   883→        partName: photo.partName || '-',
   884→        quantity: photo.quantity || '-',
   885→        isSubPart: false,
   886→        indent: 0,
   887→      });
   888→      
   889→      // Find and add all sub-parts for this main part
   890→      const subParts = additionalParts.filter(ap => ap.parentPn === photo.pn);
   891→      subParts.forEach(subPart => {
   892→        partRows.push({
   893→          pn: subPart.pn,
   894→          serialNumber: subPart.serialNumber || '',
   895→          partName: subPart.partName,
   896→          quantity: subPart.quantity,
   897→          isSubPart: true,
   898→          parentPn: photo.pn,
   899→          indent: 1,
   900→        });
   901→      });
   902→    });
   903→  
   904→  // Add any orphan additional parts (without a parent in the current photos)
   905→  const parentPns = new Set(photos.filter(p => p.pn).map(p => p.pn));
   906→  additionalParts
   907→    .filter(ap => !parentPns.has(ap.parentPn))
   908→    .forEach(orphanPart => {
   909→      partRows.push({
   910→        pn: orphanPart.pn,
   911→        serialNumber: orphanPart.serialNumber || '',
   912→        partName: orphanPart.partName,
   913→        quantity: orphanPart.quantity,
   914→        isSubPart: false,
   915→        parentPn: orphanPart.parentPn,
   916→        indent: 0,
   917→      });
   918→    });
   919→  
   920→  if (partRows.length === 0) return;
   921→  
   922→  // Calculate slides needed (8 rows per slide - peças principais + sub-peças)
   923→  const rowsPerSlide = 8;
   924→  const slidesNeeded = Math.ceil(partRows.length / rowsPerSlide);
   925→  
   926→  for (let slideIndex = 0; slideIndex < slidesNeeded; slideIndex++) {
   927→    const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   928→    addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'PARTS TABLE' : 'TABELA DE PEÇAS');
   929→    
   930→    // Table title with page indicator if multiple slides
   931→    const titleText = slidesNeeded > 1 
   932→      ? `${isTranslated ? 'Parts Table' : 'Tabela de Peças'} (${slideIndex + 1}/${slidesNeeded})`
   933→      : (isTranslated ? 'Parts Table (Part Number)' : 'Tabela de Peças (Numero da Peça)');
   934→    
   935→    slide.addText(titleText, {
   936→      x: 0.5,
   937→      y: 1.2,
   938→      w: 8,
   939→      h: 0.4,
   940→      fontSize: 14,
   941→      bold: true,
   942→      color: '000000',
   943→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   944→    });
   945→    
   946→    // Table header
   947→    const headerY = 1.7;
   948→    slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   949→      x: 0.5,
   950→      y: headerY,
   951→      w: 9,
   952→      h: 0.4,
   953→      fill: { color: '000000' },
   954→    });
   955→    
   956→    const headers = [
   957→      { text: isTranslated ? 'PN (Serial)' : 'PN (Serial)', x: 0.5, w: 2.5 },
   958→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Part Name' : 'Nome da Peça', x: 3, w: 3 },
   959→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Qty' : 'Qtd', x: 6, w: 1 },
   960→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Type' : 'Tipo', x: 7, w: 2.5 },
   961→    ];
   962→    
   963→    headers.forEach(header => {
   964→      slide.addText(header.text, {
   965→        x: header.x,
   966→        y: headerY + 0.05,
   967→        w: header.w,
   968→        h: 0.3,
   969→        fontSize: 10,
   970→        bold: true,
   971→        color: 'FFFFFF',
   972→        fontFace: 'Arial',
   973→        align: 'center',
   974→      });
   975→    });
   976→    
   977→    // Table rows
   978→    const startIdx = slideIndex * rowsPerSlide;
   979→    const endIdx = Math.min(startIdx + rowsPerSlide, partRows.length);
   980→    const slideParts = partRows.slice(startIdx, endIdx);
   981→    
   982→    let rowY = headerY + 0.4;
   983→    const rowHeight = 0.35;
   984→    
   985→    slideParts.forEach((part, idx) => {
   986→      // Row background - different colors for main and sub-parts
   987→      const bgColor = part.isSubPart ? 'FFF5E6' : (idx % 2 === 0 ? 'F8F9FA' : 'FFFFFF');
   988→      slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   989→        x: 0.5,
   990→        y: rowY,
   991→        w: 9,
   992→        h: rowHeight,
   993→        fill: { color: bgColor },
   994→        line: part.isSubPart ? { color: 'FFE0B2', width: 0.5 } : undefined,
   995→      });
   996→      
   997→      // Sub-part indicator (arrow or dash)
   998→      if (part.isSubPart) {
   999→        slide.addText('└─', {
  1000→          x: 0.5,
  1001→          y: rowY + 0.05,
  1002→          w: 0.3,
  1003→          h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1004→          fontSize: 9,
  1005→          color: 'FF6600',
  1006→          fontFace: 'Arial',
  1007→          align: 'center',
  1008→          valign: 'middle',
  1009→        });
  1010→      }
  1011→      
  1012→      // Part Number with Serial (with indent for sub-parts)
  1013→      const pnX = part.isSubPart ? 0.75 : 0.5;
  1014→      const pnText = part.serialNumber 
  1015→        ? `${part.pn} (${part.serialNumber})`
  1016→        : part.pn;
  1017→      slide.addText(pnText, {
  1018→        x: pnX,
  1019→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1020→        w: part.isSubPart ? 2.25 : 2.5,
  1021→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1022→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1023→        color: part.isSubPart ? 'CC5200' : '000000',
  1024→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1025→        align: 'center',
  1026→        valign: 'middle',
  1027→        italic: part.isSubPart,
  1028→      });
  1029→      
  1030→      // Part Name
  1031→      slide.addText(part.partName, {
  1032→        x: 3,
  1033→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1034→        w: 3,
  1035→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1036→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1037→        color: part.isSubPart ? '666666' : '000000',
  1038→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1039→        align: 'center',
  1040→        valign: 'middle',
  1041→        italic: part.isSubPart,
  1042→      });
  1043→      
  1044→      // Quantity
  1045→      slide.addText(part.quantity, {
  1046→        x: 6,
  1047→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1048→        w: 1,
  1049→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1050→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1051→        color: '000000',
  1052→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1053→        align: 'center',
  1054→        valign: 'middle',
  1055→      });
  1056→      
  1057→      // Type column
  1058→      const typeText = part.isSubPart 
  1059→        ? (isTranslated ? '↳ Sub-part' : '↳ Sub-peça')
  1060→        : (isTranslated ? 'Main' : 'Principal');
  1061→      
  1062→      slide.addText(typeText, {
  1063→        x: 7,
  1064→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1065→        w: 2.5,
  1066→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1067→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1068→        color: part.isSubPart ? 'FF6600' : '000000',
  1069→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1070→        align: 'center',
  1071→        valign: 'middle',
  1072→        italic: part.isSubPart,
  1073→      });
  1074→      
  1075→      rowY += rowHeight;
  1076→    });
  1077→    
  1078→    addStandardFooter(slide);
  1079→  }
  1080→}
  1081→

  1145→    color: 'FF6600',
  1146→    fontFace: 'Arial',
  1147→    align: 'center',

  1149→  
  1150→  slide.addText('"There is nothing so important and urgent that it can\'t be done safely"', {

  1152→    y: 4.0,
  1153→    w: 8,
  1154→    h: 0.6,
  1155→    fontSize: 22,
  1156→    bold: true,
  1157→    color: 'FF6600',

  1161→  
  1162→  // End text
  1163→  slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'END' : 'FIM', {
  1164→    x: 4,
  1165→    y: 5.0,
  1166→    w: 2,

  1174→

  1176→  if (reportId) {
  1177→    slide.addText(`ID: ${reportId}`, {

  1294→function formatDateForFileName(dateString: string): string {
  1295→  if (!dateString) return new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
  1296→  
  1297→  // Parse date manually to avoid timezone issues
  1298→  const parts = dateString.split('-');
  1299→  if (parts.length === 3) {
  1300→    const day = parts[2].padStart(2, '0');
  1301→    const month = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
  1302→    const year = parts[0];
  1303→    return `${day}-${month}-${year}`;
  1304→  }
  1305→  
  1306→  // Fallback: use current date
  1307→  const today = new Date();
  1308→  const day = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  1309→  const month = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  1310→  const year = today.getFullYear();
  1311→  return `${day}-${month}-${year}`;
  1312→}
  1313→
  1314→function formatDateForDisplay(dateString: string): string {
  1315→  if (!dateString) return '';
  1316→  
  1317→  // Parse date manually to avoid timezone issues (YYYY-MM-DD format)
  1318→  const parts = dateString.split('-');
  1319→  if (parts.length === 3) {
  1320→    const day = parts[2].padStart(2, '0');
  1321→    const month = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
  1322→    const year = parts[0];
  1323→    return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
  1324→  }
  1325→  
  1326→  return dateString;
  1327→}
  1328→
